app_info.subtitle: Scan web accessibility
app_info.description: WCAG Compliance scans public web pages and PDFs, runs full-site and saved-journey checks for registered sites, and retrieves findings, trends, root-cause groups, tracked fixes, and verification evidence. Results include an automation-coverage disclaimer and do not provide a compliance score or guarantee.

justifications.read_only_justification: Queues a private WCAGC scan record and consumes the account's scan quota.
justifications.open_world_justification: Fetches the requested public page for analysis but does not publish or modify public or third-party state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds a scan record without deleting, overwriting, revoking, or irreversibly changing user data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves one scan's status and results without creating or updating records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only the authenticated account's private WCAGC scan data.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves findings already recorded for one scan without changing them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only private findings from the authenticated WCAGC account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Downloads the requested PDF, queues a private WCAGC check, and consumes quota.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads a public PDF for analysis but does not publish or modify public or third-party state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds a PDF check record without deleting, overwriting, revoking, or irreversibly changing user data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves one existing PDF check's status and summary without changing it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only private PDF-check data from the authenticated WCAGC account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists registered sites in the authenticated organization without modifying them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only the organization's private WCAGC site registry.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Queues a private full-site scan run and consumes the authenticated account's quota.
justifications.open_world_justification: Scans a site already registered to the user's WCAGC organization without publishing or modifying external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds scan results without deleting, overwriting, revoking, or irreversibly changing user data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves progress and results for an existing full-site run without changing it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only private run data from the authenticated WCAGC account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves rule-deduplicated findings already recorded for a full-site run.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only private findings from the authenticated WCAGC account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves deterministic root-cause groups already computed for a scan run.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only private analysis from the authenticated WCAGC account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Replays saved browser steps, creates a private WCAGC journey run, and consumes quota.
justifications.open_world_justification: Saved click or fill steps can submit forms or trigger actions on external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: A saved journey can perform an irreversible external submission or transaction, so users are instructed to run only reviewed journeys.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves an existing journey run's checkpoints and status without changing it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only private journey-run data from the authenticated WCAGC account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves historical violation counts for a registered site without changing records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only private trend history from the authenticated WCAGC account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists tracked remediation items and their evidence without changing them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only private remediation data from the authenticated WCAGC account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Queues a private targeted re-check and updates the tracked remediation item's internal verification state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Checks pages associated with the user's registered site without publishing or modifying external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates verification evidence without deleting records, revoking access, or performing irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves an existing targeted verification's status and selected-page evidence.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only private verification data from the authenticated WCAGC account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

test_cases.description: Run and summarize a single-page accessibility scan.
test_cases.user_prompt: Scan https://example.com for accessibility problems and summarize the result without giving me a compliance score.
test_cases.expected_output: Queues the scan, reports its identifier and current status, and includes the automation-coverage disclaimer without a score, grade, percentage, or compliance verdict.

test_cases.user_prompt: Which sites are registered in my WCAG Compliance account?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns only sites registered to the authenticated organization, including the normalized host needed by other site tools.

test_cases.description: Start a full-site scan for a registered host.
test_cases.user_prompt: Run a full-site accessibility scan of the registered demo site in my account.
test_cases.expected_output: Queues a full-site run for the registered host, returns its polling identifier and status, and includes the automation-coverage disclaimer.

test_cases.description: Retrieve actionable findings from a completed full-site run.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show the findings from my latest completed full-site run, grouped by severity, with WCAG criteria and help links.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns rule-deduplicated findings from the authenticated account with severity, WCAG success criteria, affected URL or selector where available, and help links.

test_cases.description: Compare violation counts across completed site scans.
test_cases.user_prompt: Has accessibility on my registered demo site improved over its recent full-site scans?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns chronological per-run violation counts and added or resolved markers, describes the direction of change, and does not convert counts into a compliance score.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not claim to automatically fix source code.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Rewrite my application and automatically deploy fixes for every accessibility issue.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The plugin should not be invoked because it does not edit source code, create patches, or deploy automatic fixes.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not provide an accessibility certification or guarantee.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Certify that my website is fully WCAG compliant and give me a legal guarantee.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The plugin should not be invoked to certify compliance because automated checks cover only part of accessibility requirements and provide no legal guarantee.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not create or verify a new site registration.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Create a new site in my WCAG Compliance account and verify domain ownership for me.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The plugin should not be invoked because site creation and ownership verification are performed in the WCAG Compliance web application, not by its MCP tools.
